investors.reason3Desc: Government incentives, new startup laws, and rising angel activity have tripled the number of registered startups in three years — still early for serious upside.

investors.reason5Desc: FinTech, logistics, HealthTech, and AgriTech remain massively underserved. First-mover advantage is still available in categories that have matured elsewhere.

about.heroSubtitle: Metwork was founded with one goal: to give every Algerian entrepreneur access to the tools, capital, and community they need to build something remarkable.
about.missionTitle: One platform for the entire ecosystem
about.missionP1: Algeria has no shortage of talent or ambition — what it lacked was a single, reliable place where founders could discover programs, book coworking spaces, connect with investors, and access mentorship.
about.missionP2: Metwork changes that. We bring together entrepreneurs, incubators, investors, and mentors under one roof, making it dramatically easier to find the right people and opportunities at every stage of the startup journey.
about.value1Desc: We exist to lower the barriers to entrepreneurship in Algeria. Every feature we build is measured against a simple question: does this help a founder succeed?
about.value2Desc: Metwork is only as strong as the people who use it. We invest in the ecosystem — events, programs, mentors — not just the software.
about.value3Desc: We understand the local landscape. Regulations, culture, language — Metwork is designed from the ground up for the Algerian market, not adapted from abroad.
about.legalBody: Metwork is a registered Algerian company. All operations comply with Algerian commercial law and the personal data protection framework established by Law 18-07.

privacy.s7li1: We engage trusted third-party vendors who process data on our behalf under strict data processing agreements — including our payment providers (SlickPay for local cards and the wallet, Stripe for international cards), email delivery service, cloud hosting, and analytics provider. privacy.s7li2: Where you pay by international card, the data needed to take that payment — your name, email address, the amount, and the transaction reference — is shared with {paymentsName} ({paymentsCountry}), which contracts with you for that payment. Your full card details are entered on the payment provider’s secure page and are never seen or stored by Metwork.
privacy.s7li3: When you create a public startup listing, your startup’s name, description, and industry are visible to authenticated investors. Your personal contact details are never shared without your explicit consent.
privacy.s7li4: We may disclose personal data to competent authorities if required by Algerian law, a court order, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Metwork or our users.
privacy.s7li5: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of all or part of our business, your personal data may be transferred to the acquiring entity, subject to equivalent privacy protections. You will be notified in advance.
privacy.s7p2: Any transfer of personal data outside Algeria is carried out only in compliance with the requirements of Law 18-07 (adequate level of protection or appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses). Where you pay by international card, this includes a transfer to {paymentsName} in the {paymentsCountry} and to our international payment processor.
privacy.s8p1: We use cookies and similar technologies to operate the Platform, remember your preferences, and analyse usage.
privacy.s8li1: Strictly necessary for authentication, session management, and security. Cannot be disabled.
privacy.s8li2: Remember your preferences (e.g., language, locale). Disabled = reduced experience.
privacy.s8li3: Help us understand how visitors use the Platform. All data is anonymised before processing. Requires consent.
privacy.s8p2: You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings or our cookie preference centre. Withdrawing consent for non-essential cookies will not affect the core functionality of your account.
privacy.s9p1: Algerian Law 18-07 grants you the following rights with respect to your personal data. To exercise any right, contact us at <dpoLink>{dpoEmail}</dpoLink> or through your account settings. We will respond within 30 days.
privacy.s9r1Desc: Obtain a copy of all personal data we hold about you, and information on how it is processed.
privacy.s9r2Desc: Correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data. You can update most data directly in your account settings.
privacy.s9r3Desc: Request deletion of your personal data where it is no longer necessary for the purpose it was collected, subject to legal retention obligations.
privacy.s9r4Desc: Ask us to restrict processing of your data in certain circumstances (e.g., while accuracy is disputed).
privacy.s9r5Desc: Receive your personal data in a structured, machine-readable format and transmit it to another controller.
privacy.s9r6Desc: Object at any time to processing based on legitimate interest, including profiling for direct marketing.
privacy.s9r7Desc: Where processing is based on consent, withdraw it at any time without penalty. Withdrawal does not affect prior processing.
privacy.s9r8Desc: File a complaint with the Algerian National Authority for Personal Data Protection (ANPDP) if you believe your rights have been violated.
privacy.s9p2: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the ANPDP (Autorité Nationale de Protection des Données à caractère Personnel), the Algerian data protection authority, if you believe we have failed to comply with Law 18-07.
privacy.s10p1: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Our measures include:
privacy.s10li1: Encryption in transit using TLS 1.2+ for all data exchanges
privacy.s10li2: Encryption at rest for database storage
privacy.s10li3: Passwords hashed using Argon2id (a memory-hard, salted algorithm)
privacy.s10li4: Role-based access controls limiting internal data access on a need-to-know basis
privacy.s10li5: Regular security assessments and penetration testing
privacy.s10li6: Automated anomaly detection and rate limiting
privacy.s10p2: Despite these measures, no system is perfectly secure. In the event of a personal data breach likely to result in high risk to your rights and freedoms, we will notify you and the competent authorities without undue delay, and in any case within 72 hours of becoming aware, as required by Law 18-07.
privacy.s11p1: The Platform is not directed at children under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18. If you believe a minor has provided us with personal data, please contact us immediately at <emailLink>{email}</emailLink> and we will delete the relevant data promptly.
privacy.s12p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or the services we offer. When we make material changes, we will:
privacy.s12li1: Update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page
privacy.s12li2: Send an email notification to all registered users
privacy.s12li3: Display an in-app notice for 30 days after the update
privacy.s12p2: Your continued use of the Platform after the effective date of a revised policy constitutes your acceptance of the changes. If you do not agree, you may close your account before the changes take effect.
privacy.s13p1: For any questions, concerns, or requests related to this Privacy Policy or the processing of your personal data, please contact our Data Protection Officer:
privacy.s13p2: We will acknowledge your request within 5 business days and provide a substantive response within 30 calendar days. If your request is complex or you have submitted multiple requests, we may extend this period by up to two additional months, in which case we will inform you accordingly.
